findings.section: Details → Edge cases ("Тег в документации разошёлся с реальностью")
findings.issue: Sequencing gap in the tag-divergence handling across three tasks. Task 07 runs in wave 4 and writes the Dockerfile literal into deployment.md; the actual publish happens in Task 08 (wave 5). Task 07's edge case tells *its own executor* to "обнаружив расхождение, остановиться и эскалировать" — but at wave 4 there is nothing to compare against, the divergence can only surface during Task 08. Task 08's Post-completion says "Если тег отличается от 0.0.11 — синхронизировать Task 9 и deployment.md (Task 7)", while task 09's Details say deployment.md is Task 07's file and must not be edited there. Net effect: if the published tag differs, the re-edit of deployment.md has no unambiguous owner and lands on an already-closed task.
findings.fix: Name the owner explicitly: state in task 08's Post-completion that the deployment.md re-edit is performed as part of task 08's own follow-up (task 07 being closed by then), and reword task 07's edge case to "if a later task finds the published tag differs, deployment.md is re-edited there" rather than instructing task 07's executor to detect it.
